incident_spec.summary: ALTER TABLE operation caused blocking due to lock contention.
symptoms: Database froze during ALTER TABLE operation
Login system was blocked due to SELECT dependency on the locked table
incident_spec.mechanism: ALTER TABLE requires an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, and lock contention occurred due to long-lived weak locks.
